slides.h:
Microbiology: Viruses, Bacteria and Archaea · 1/11

Is a virus alive?病毒是生命吗？

A virus has genetic material and evolves, but it has no cells, no metabolism of its own and cannot reproduce alone. Most biologists place it on the edge of life.病毒有遗传物质，也会演化，但没有细胞，没有自己的新陈代谢，也不能独立繁殖。多数生物学家把它放在生命的边缘。

Microbiology: Viruses, Bacteria and Archaea · 2/11

Parts of a virus病毒的结构

Genetic material (DNA or RNA) sits inside a protein coat called a capsid. Some viruses add an outer envelope. Spikes help them attach to a host cell.遗传物质（DNA 或 RNA）在称为衣壳的蛋白质外壳里；有的病毒还有外层包膜；刺突帮助它们附着在宿主细胞上。

Microbiology: Viruses, Bacteria and Archaea · 3/11

Lytic cycle裂解周期

The virus attaches, injects its DNA, makes many copies using the host cell, and bursts it open. The new viruses go on to infect other cells.病毒附着、注入 DNA，利用宿主细胞复制出许多拷贝，再使细胞破裂；新病毒继续感染其他细胞。

Microbiology: Viruses, Bacteria and Archaea · 4/11

Lysogenic cycle溶原周期

The viral DNA joins the host chromosome and is copied each time the cell divides. A trigger, such as stress, can switch it to the lytic cycle.病毒 DNA 整合进宿主染色体，随细胞每次分裂被复制；压力等诱因可以让它转入裂解周期。

Microbiology: Viruses, Bacteria and Archaea · 5/11

Anatomy of a bacterium细菌的结构

A bacterium has a cell wall, a cell membrane, ribosomes and a ring of DNA in the nucleoid. It has no nucleus. Some have a capsule, flagella or pili.细菌有细胞壁、细胞膜、核糖体，DNA 成环状位于拟核；没有细胞核。有些还有荚膜、鞭毛或菌毛。

Microbiology: Viruses, Bacteria and Archaea · 6/11

Three bacterial shapes细菌的三种形状

Cocci are round, bacilli are rods, and spirilla are spirals. Shape is one clue for identifying bacteria.球菌是圆的，杆菌是棒状，螺旋菌是螺旋形。形状是鉴定细菌的一条线索。

Microbiology: Viruses, Bacteria and Archaea · 7/11

How bacteria reproduce细菌如何繁殖

Binary fission makes two identical cells, so bacteria can multiply very fast. Conjugation does not make new cells; it passes DNA between cells.二分裂产生两个相同的细胞，所以细菌能很快增多；接合不产生新细胞，只在细胞间传递 DNA。

Microbiology: Viruses, Bacteria and Archaea · 8/11

Helpful bacteria有益的细菌

Decomposers recycle dead matter. Nitrogen fixers feed plants. Cyanobacteria add oxygen. Gut bacteria help digestion and make some vitamins.分解者循环利用死亡物质；固氮菌给植物提供氮；蓝细菌释放氧气；肠道细菌帮助消化并合成部分维生素。

Microbiology: Viruses, Bacteria and Archaea · 9/11

Bacteria or archaea?细菌还是古菌？

Both are single-celled prokaryotes with no nucleus. Bacterial walls contain peptidoglycan; archaeal walls do not. Archaea are often found in extreme places.两者都是没有细胞核的单细胞原核生物。细菌的细胞壁含肽聚糖，古菌的不含。古菌常见于极端环境。

Microbiology: Viruses, Bacteria and Archaea · 10/11

Antibiotics and viruses抗生素与病毒

Antibiotics attack bacterial structures such as the cell wall. Viruses have none of these, so antibiotics do nothing against a cold or flu.抗生素攻击细菌的结构，如细胞壁；病毒没有这些结构，所以抗生素对感冒和流感无效。

Microbiology: Viruses, Bacteria and Archaea · 11/11

Vaccines疫苗

A vaccine shows the immune system a harmless piece of a germ. The body builds memory cells and can respond quickly if the real germ arrives.疫苗让免疫系统接触无害的病原体片段，身体产生记忆细胞，真正的病原体到来时就能快速应对。

cards.f: mi·cro·OR·gan·ism
cards.b:
A living thing too small to see without a microscope.

微生物：小到不用显微镜就看不见的生物。

🧠 micro = small, organism = living thing.micro = 小，organism = 生物。

Quick check: Can you see a single bacterium without a microscope?

No. It is only a few micrometres long.

cards.f: VI·rus
cards.b:
A tiny particle of genetic material inside a protein coat that can only reproduce inside a host cell.

病毒：蛋白质外壳包着遗传物质的微小颗粒，只能在宿主细胞内繁殖。

🧠 virus = Latin for poison.virus 在拉丁语里是「毒」。

Quick check: Can a virus reproduce on its own?

No. It needs a host cell.

cards.f: CAP·sid
cards.b:
The protein coat that surrounds and protects a virus's genetic material.

衣壳：包围并保护病毒遗传物质的蛋白质外壳。

🧠 capsid ~ capsule: a protein box.capsid 像个「蛋白质盒子」。

Quick check: What is a capsid made of?

Protein.

cards.f: VI·ral EN·ve·lope
cards.b:
An outer membrane some viruses take from the host cell, studded with spikes.

病毒包膜：部分病毒从宿主细胞获得的外层膜，上面有刺突。

🧠 envelope = the wrapper around a letter.envelope = 信封：包在外面的一层。

Quick check: Where does a viral envelope come from?

From the host cell's membrane.

cards.f: HOST CELL
cards.b:
The living cell a virus enters and uses to make more viruses.

宿主细胞：病毒进入并利用来制造更多病毒的活细胞。

🧠 host = the one who "hosts" a guest.host = 接待客人的主人。

Quick check: Why does a virus need a host cell?

It has no machinery of its own to make proteins and copy itself.

cards.f: OB·li·gate PAR·a·site
cards.b:
An organism that cannot survive or reproduce without living in or on a host.

专性寄生物：离开宿主就无法生存或繁殖的寄生生物。

🧠 obligate = obliged, forced. They must have a host.obligate = 非如此不可。

Quick check: Why are viruses called obligate parasites?

They can reproduce only inside a host cell.

cards.f: bac·TE·ri·o·phage
cards.b:
A virus that infects bacteria.

噬菌体：专门感染细菌的病毒。

🧠 bacterio- = bacteria, -phage = eater. Bacteria eater.bacterio- = 细菌，-phage = 吞食。

Quick check: What does a bacteriophage infect?

Bacteria.

cards.f: LYT·ic CY·cle
cards.b:
A virus cycle in which the virus copies itself fast and bursts the host cell.

裂解周期：病毒迅速复制并使宿主细胞破裂的循环。

🧠 lysis = splitting open. Lytic = bursts the cell.lysis = 裂开。

Quick check: What happens to the host cell at the end of the lytic cycle?

It bursts (lyses) and releases new viruses.

cards.f: ly·so·GEN·ic CY·cle
cards.b:
A virus cycle in which viral DNA joins the host's DNA and is copied quietly each time the cell divides.

溶原周期：病毒 DNA 整合进宿主 DNA，随细胞分裂被悄悄复制的循环。

🧠 lyso + -genic = produces lysis later. Sleeping first, bursting later.先潜伏，后裂解。

Quick check: Does the host cell die right away in the lysogenic cycle?

No. The viral DNA stays hidden and is copied as the cell divides.

cards.f: RET·ro·vi·rus
cards.b:
An RNA virus that copies its RNA into DNA, which joins the host's DNA. HIV is one.

逆转录病毒：把自己的 RNA 反转录成 DNA 并整合进宿主 DNA 的 RNA 病毒，HIV 即是。

🧠 retro = backwards. Information flows RNA back to DNA.retro = 向后：RNA 反向变成 DNA。

Quick check: What does a retrovirus make from its RNA?

DNA.

cards.f: vac·CINE
cards.b:
A harmless piece or weakened form of a germ that trains the immune system to fight the real one.

疫苗：无害的病原体片段或减弱的病原体，用来训练免疫系统对抗真正的病原体。

🧠 vacca = cow. The first vaccine used cowpox.vacca = 牛：第一支疫苗用的是牛痘。

Quick check: Does a vaccine give you the disease?

No. It contains only a harmless piece or weakened germ.

cards.f: PATH·o·gen
cards.b:
Any organism or virus that causes disease.

病原体：任何引起疾病的生物或病毒。

🧠 patho = disease, -gen = producer.patho = 疾病，-gen = 产生。

Quick check: Name a bacterial pathogen.

Streptococcus (strep throat) or Salmonella, for example.

cards.f: an·ti·bi·OT·ic
cards.b:
A medicine that kills bacteria or stops them growing. It does not work on viruses.

抗生素：杀死细菌或抑制其生长的药物，对病毒无效。

🧠 anti = against, bio = life.anti = 对抗，bio = 生命。

Quick check: Should you take an antibiotic for a cold?

No. A cold is caused by a virus.

cards.f: CELL WALL
cards.b:
A stiff outer layer that protects and shapes a cell, found in bacteria, archaea, plants and fungi.

细胞壁：位于细胞膜外的坚硬外层，保护并塑造细胞，见于细菌、古菌、植物和真菌。

🧠 wall around a castle.像城墙。

Quick check: Do animal cells have a cell wall?

No.

cards.f: pep·ti·do·GLY·can
cards.b:
The mesh of sugars and amino acids that makes up the cell wall of most bacteria.

肽聚糖：构成大多数细菌细胞壁的糖与氨基酸网状结构。

🧠 Pepti = protein bits, glycan = sugar. Protein + sugar = wall mesh.pepti = 蛋白质，glycan = 糖：蛋白质加糖。

Quick check: Which cell wall contains peptidoglycan: bacteria or plants?

Bacteria.

cards.f: NU·cle·oid
cards.b:
The region of a prokaryote where its circular DNA is found. It has no membrane.

拟核：原核细胞中存放环状 DNA 的区域，没有膜包裹。

🧠 nucleoid = "nucleus-like".nucleoid = 像核的区域。

Quick check: Does the nucleoid have a membrane?

No.

cards.f: PLAS·mid
cards.b:
A small ring of extra DNA in a bacterium, often carrying genes such as antibiotic resistance.

质粒：细菌中一小环额外的 DNA，常带有抗生素耐药性等基因。

🧠 plasmid = a little "plasma" ring.小环状 DNA。

Quick check: Can plasmids move between bacteria?

Yes, for example during conjugation.

cards.f: fla·GEL·lum
cards.b:
A long whip-like tail that moves a cell. In bacteria it spins like a propeller. Plural: flagella.

鞭毛：推动细胞运动的长鞭状结构；细菌的鞭毛像螺旋桨一样旋转。复数 flagella。

🧠 flagellum = Latin for whip.flagellum 在拉丁语里是「鞭子」。

Quick check: What does a flagellum do?

It moves the cell.

cards.f: PI·lus
cards.b:
A short hair-like projection on a bacterium used to stick to surfaces or to pass DNA. Plural: pili.

菌毛：细菌表面短短的毛状突起，用来黏附表面或传递 DNA。复数 pili。

🧠 pilus = hair.pilus 意为「毛」。

Quick check: Give one job of a pilus.

Attaching to surfaces, or passing DNA in conjugation.

cards.f: CAP·sule
cards.b:
A sticky outer layer around some bacterial cells that protects them and helps them stick.

荚膜：部分细菌细胞外一层黏黏的保护层，帮助附着。

🧠 capsule = a protective case.capsule = 保护壳。

Quick check: What is a capsule for?

Protection and sticking to surfaces.

cards.f: RI·bo·some
cards.b:
A tiny structure that builds proteins. All cells have them.

核糖体：制造蛋白质的微小结构，所有细胞都有。

🧠 ribo = from RNA, soma = body.ribo = 核糖，soma = 小体。

Quick check: Do prokaryotes have ribosomes?

Yes. All cells do.

cards.f: COC·cus
cards.b:
A round or sphere-shaped bacterium. Plural: cocci.

球菌：圆形或球形的细菌。复数 cocci。

🧠 coccus = Greek kokkos = berry.kokkos = 浆果：圆圆的。

Quick check: Which shape is a coccus?

Round (a sphere).

cards.f: ba·CIL·lus
cards.b:
A rod-shaped bacterium. Plural: bacilli.

杆菌：棒状的细菌。复数 bacilli。

🧠 bacillus = little rod.bacillus = 小棍子。

Quick check: Which shape is a bacillus?

Rod-shaped.

cards.f: spi·RIL·lum
cards.b:
A spiral or corkscrew-shaped bacterium. Plural: spirilla.

螺旋菌：螺旋形或开瓶器形的细菌。复数 spirilla。

🧠 spiral = spirillum.spiral 即螺旋。

Quick check: What shape is a spirillum?

A spiral.

cards.f: BI·na·ry FIS·sion
cards.b:
How a bacterium reproduces: it copies its DNA, grows, and splits into two identical cells.

二分裂：细菌的繁殖方式：复制 DNA，长大后分裂成两个相同的细胞。

🧠 binary = two, fission = splitting.binary = 二，fission = 分裂。

Quick check: How many cells result from one round of binary fission?

Two.

cards.f: con·ju·GA·tion
cards.b:
Two bacteria join by a pilus and pass DNA, such as a plasmid, from one to the other.

接合：两个细菌通过菌毛连接，把一段 DNA（如质粒）从一个传给另一个。

🧠 con- = together, jugum = yoke. Joined together.con- = 一起，jugum = 轭：连在一起。

Quick check: Is conjugation reproduction?

No. It swaps DNA, but does not make new cells.

cards.f: EN·do·spore
cards.b:
A tough, dormant form some bacteria make to survive heat, dryness and chemicals.

内生孢子：部分细菌形成的坚韧休眠体，可耐受高温、干燥和化学物质。

🧠 endo = inside. Spore formed inside.endo = 内部。

Quick check: Why are endospores a problem for food safety?

They survive heat that kills ordinary bacteria.

cards.f: ae·RO·bic
cards.b:
Needing oxygen to live or to make energy.

需氧的：需要氧气才能生存或产生能量。

🧠 aero = air.aero = 空气。

Quick check: Are humans aerobic or anaerobic?

Aerobic.

cards.f: an·ae·RO·bic
cards.b:
Living or working without oxygen.

厌氧的：不需要氧气也能生存或工作。

🧠 an- = without. Without air.an- = 没有。

Quick check: What does "an-" mean in anaerobic?

Without.

cards.f: de·com·PO·ser
cards.b:
An organism, such as a bacterium or fungus, that breaks down dead matter and returns nutrients to the soil.

分解者：把死亡有机物分解、将养分还给土壤的生物，如细菌和真菌。

🧠 de- = undo, compose = put together. Take apart.de- = 拆开，compose = 组合。

Quick check: Name two kinds of decomposers.

Bacteria and fungi.

cards.f: NI·tro·gen fix·A·tion
cards.b:
Bacteria turning nitrogen gas from the air into ammonia that plants can use.

固氮作用：细菌把空气中的氮气转化成植物能利用的氨。

🧠 fix = lock into a usable form.fix = 固定成可利用的形式。

Quick check: Why do plants need nitrogen-fixing bacteria?

Plants cannot use nitrogen gas, but they can use the ammonia the bacteria make.

cards.f: cy·a·no·bac·TE·ri·a
cards.b:
Photosynthetic bacteria that make their own food from light and release oxygen.

蓝细菌：能进行光合作用、利用光自制食物并释放氧气的细菌。

🧠 cyan = blue-green. Blue-green bacteria.cyan = 蓝绿色。

Quick check: What gas do cyanobacteria release?

Oxygen.

cards.f: MU·tu·al·ism
cards.b:
A relationship in which both species benefit.

互利共生：双方物种都受益的关系。

🧠 mutual = both sides gain.mutual = 双方都得益。

Quick check: Name an example of mutualism.

Gut bacteria and humans, or nitrogen-fixing bacteria and legume roots.

cards.f: MI·cro·bi·ome
cards.b:
The community of microbes that live on and inside a body.

微生物组：生活在身体表面和体内的微生物群落。

🧠 micro = small, -ome = whole collection.-ome = 全部的集合。

Quick check: Where is the largest part of your microbiome found?

In the gut (intestines).

cards.f: ex·TREM·o·phile
cards.b:
An organism, often an archaeon, that thrives in extreme conditions such as heat, salt or acid.

极端微生物：在高温、高盐或强酸等极端环境中茁壮生长的生物，常为古菌。

🧠 extreme + -phile (lover).extreme + -phile（爱好者）。

Quick check: What does the ending -phile mean?

Lover of.

cards.f: HAL·o·phile
cards.b:
An organism that lives in very salty places.

嗜盐菌：生活在高盐环境中的生物。

🧠 halo = salt, -phile = lover.halo = 盐。

Quick check: What does a halophile love?

Salt.

cards.f: THER·mo·phile
cards.b:
An organism that thrives at high temperatures, such as in hot springs.

嗜热菌：在温泉等高温环境中茁壮生长的生物。

🧠 thermo = heat, as in thermometer.thermo = 热。

Quick check: What does a thermophile love?

Heat.

cards.f: meth·AN·o·gen
cards.b:
An archaeon that makes methane gas and cannot live where there is oxygen.

产甲烷菌：能产生甲烷气体的古菌，不能在有氧的环境生活。

🧠 methane + -gen (producer).methane + -gen（产生者）。

Quick check: What gas does a methanogen make?

Methane.

cards.f: BI·o·film
cards.b:
A thin, slimy layer of microbes stuck to a surface, such as plaque on teeth.

生物膜：附着在表面的一层黏滑的微生物，如牙菌斑。

🧠 bio = life, film = thin layer.bio = 生命，film = 薄层。

Quick check: Give an example of a biofilm.

Dental plaque, or the slime on a river stone.
